captures.q: What is “EA-CORPORA-25 — The Twenty-Fifth Seating” by Lee Sharks (Alexanarch deposit #1708, AXN:072B), and how does it work? Ground your answer in the document itself.
captures.description: EA-CORPORA-25 ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, AT THE RECORD PAGE'S LINK TEXT NAMING THE TITLE, #1708 AND AXN:072B: one turn that reads the deposit's body closely and gets its mechanism right in every particular checked (the five seats and their record numbers, the edition names, record bytes against registry hashes and site files against git blobs at commit 12e6aa78, the verified loci, the Forty-Six Golden Tickets bound as glyphic checksum with the seal '∮ = 1', the exclusions, the #83 whitespace exception, 29,012 lines in 22 works, 32 files). It drops what the deposit says about why these editions and why here: the seating after Pearl and Other Poems at 03/02 and on its terms, the form it follows from EA-CORPORA-24, the Good Gray Poet, the Waltian canon and the Prince of Poets, and the persons in the titles.
